items.html: And when the pleasant son was born, three brains were made for him through the upper river: 'from the brook in the way he will drink, therefore he will lift up the head'; therefore the Vav in the Name, opposite it, has a head. 'And the woman took the child and nursed him,' in the secret of 'He establishes the heavens by understanding,' for she weighs it down, because all the three brains came to him through her. However, the brain in him that spreads into fifty gates, from her and of herself, enters the head of ZA in the secret of the milk of his mother; and this is through Aba, who brought the Bina outside in the secret of the closed Mem, to nurse her son; and the plantings that were like the horns of locusts grew.
